recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-24642 unless HL7 V2 terminology changes again or the comparison page is substantively rewritten.
issue_request: FHIR-24642 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core comparison-page clarification requesting that the HL7 V2 comparison page replace the term "null" with the updated HL7 V2.9 term "delete indicator".
initial_application: The issue had already been applied. Jira records merge commit c6a60ab3e83393ffe8b85af2b25e4b21e28f13b1, and the underlying source commit 5725bad7f8557dcf70740c21a00e32e8e7e83edf changed source/comparison-v2.html from "Nulls and update modes" and "null" to "Delete indicator and update modes" and "a delete indicator".
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists comparison-v2.html under the Comparison page and source/comparison.html links to it from the appendix, confirming the inspected source is in the current page set. FHIR-I minutes from 2019-11-25 record the FHIR-24642 Persuasive vote. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no related or conflicting later decision that changes the terminology.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/comparison-v2.html already says "Delete indicator and update modes" and describes fields populated with a "delete indicator"; the old standalone "null" wording is absent from the relevant page.
